justification: Published council list updated to the list the check computes (adds Penrith and Wollongong). No code, query or served logic changes.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: the published list differs from the computed list in either direction
falsifiable_check.observed_red: On main it prints 'passes but not published: penrith, wollongong' and exits 1; after the change it prints PASS with 8 of 18 listed.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: The list is computed from the database by the check itself; nothing is typed by hand.

pre_impl.existing_data: No data read or written by this change.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Another session proved the last unproven rows in Penrith and Wollongong, so both now pass.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Two councils join the what-you-get list (6 to 8).

break_it.scenario: a listed council later gains an unproven rule
break_it.how: the check fails until the list is updated
